# ChainFolioAI

> ChainFolioAI is a read-only crypto + traditional portfolio tracker with real-time PNL, advanced metrics, multi-country tax tools, and an AI assistant that knows your real portfolio. It has a public REST API and an MCP integration, so AI agents can connect to it. 100% read-only, non-custodial — it never accesses private keys or moves funds. Web app, multilingual (PT/EN/ES/FR), free to start.

## What it does
- Consolidates crypto (on-chain wallets, exchanges, DeFi, NFTs, stablecoins, manual assets) and traditional assets in one dashboard.
- Real-time profit/loss (PNL), portfolio Score (0-100), and benchmarks vs BTC, ETH, S&P 500 and Gold.
- Advanced metrics: ROI, CAGR, Sharpe ratio, Max Drawdown, volatility.
- Crypto tax (FIFO capital gains) for 14 countries, with CSV/PDF export.
- FIRE (financial independence) calculator.
- Live market: prices, BTC/ETH dominance, Fear & Greed, derivatives (open interest, funding, long/short, CVD), TradingView charts, AI-summarized news, daily AI briefing.
- Smart Money: track 50+ whale wallets and their on-chain moves (ETH/BTC/SOL).
- AI assistants: "Chain" (in-app chat that knows your real portfolio and the platform) and "Block" (a Premium dedicated AI portfolio manager).
- Multi-portfolio: several isolated accounts (Pro: 3, Premium: 10).

## For AI agents and developers
- REST API and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration are available on the Premium plan, so an AI agent can read a user's portfolio programmatically.
- Developer docs: https://chainfolioai.com/developers

## Key pages
- [Home](https://chainfolioai.com/): product overview.
- [How it works](https://chainfolioai.com/como-funciona): tool-by-tool walkthrough.
- [Pricing](https://chainfolioai.com/pricing): Free (€0), Pro (€14.99/mo), Premium (€39/mo). Payable by card (Stripe) or crypto stablecoins (Helio).
- [Developers (API + MCP)](https://chainfolioai.com/developers): programmatic access for apps and AI agents.
- [Terms](https://chainfolioai.com/termos)
- [Privacy](https://chainfolioai.com/privacidade)

## Notes
- Non-custodial and read-only: users connect wallets by public address or read-only API keys. The app never asks for private keys or seed phrases.
- Not financial advice: the AI describes and explains, it never tells users what to buy or sell.
